The inter-departmental communication between the Special District Revenue Officer (Land Acquisition) and the District Registrar, Salem District in proceedings dated 30.11.2021 is under challenge in the present writ petition.

The inter-departmental communications between the Authorities for the purpose of ascertaining the value of the acquired property would not provide a cause for the writ petitioner to file the present writ petition.
The petitioner will get opportunity to defend his case during the course of the acquisition proceedings.
3 . T h e l a n d b e l o n g e d t o t h e p e t i t i o n e r i s p r o p o s e d t o b e a c q u i r e d f o r Chennai-Kanyakumari-Industrial Corridor Project.

The learned Additional Government Pleader,
based on the written instructions given by the Special District Revenue Officer (Land Acquisition),
made a submission that the guideline value will be decided by the District Level Committee as per G.O.No.75 Commercial Taxes and Registration (J1) dated 01.06.2010.
The District Level committee is scheduled to be convened on 14.09.2023 i.e. today.
The Committee has to consider various factors and take a decision on merits and in accordance with law.
4. In the present case, admittedly, award has not been passed and the compensation is yet to be determined.

5. Lands are sought to be acquired for the public projects and the petitioner undoubtedly is entitled for compensation in accordance with the provisions of the land acquisition Act.
The petitioner is entitled to submit his objections under the provisions of the Act.
Thus, the petitioner is at liberty to do so or seek an enhancement of compensation after passing the award, as the case may be, by following the procedure as contemplated.
6. With this liberty, the Writ Petition stands dismissed.
No costs.
